description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmitted" name="All products selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AddressPaymentDone" name="Address and payment completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OnlineShopOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" name="Login request" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_Login" targetRef="Start_ShopLogin"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginConfirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginResult" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSubmitted" name="All products selected" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Catch_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AddressPaymentDone" name="Address and payment completed" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentDone" sourceRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentDone" targetRef="Catch_AddressPaymentDone"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Login" name="Log in with credentials" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginResult" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ProductsMerge" name="Merge product selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AllSelected" name="All products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order selection" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data to bank" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_WaitSplit" name="Split waiting activities"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AddressCheck" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_BillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AddressMerge" name="Merge address handling"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_WaitJoin" name="Join waiting activities"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AddressPaymentDone" name="Confirm address and payment completed" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentDone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerDone" name="Order data submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="SendTask_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="SendTask_Login" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_LoginResult" targetRef="Gw_ProductsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_LoginResult" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="Gw_ProductsMerge" targetRef="UserTask_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gw_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Gw_ProductsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="UserTask_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Gw_WaitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Gw_WaitSplit" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="Gw_WaitSplit" targetRef="UserTask_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="UserTask_ShippingAddress" targetRef="Gw_AddressCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AddressCheck" targetRef="UserTask_BillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AddressCheck" targetRef="Gw_AddressMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" sourceRef="UserTask_BillingAddress" targetRef="Gw_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" sourceRef="Gw_AddressMerge" targetRef="Gw_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Gw_WaitJoin" targetRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentDone" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ShopLogin" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginResult" name="Send login result" messageRef="Msg_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginOK" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OrderSubmitted" name="All products selected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_PrepSplit" name="Split preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_PrepJoin" name="Join preparation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_AddressPaymentDone" name="Address and payment completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AddressPaymentDone" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="Start_ShopLogin" targetRef="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials" targetRef="SendTask_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S03" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginResult" targetRef="Gw_LoginOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_LoginOK" targetRef="Catch_OrderSubmitted">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_LoginOK" targetRef="End_LoginRejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="Catch_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gw_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Gw_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gw_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gw_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gw_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Gw_PrepJoin" targetRef="Catch_AddressPaymentDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Catch_AddressPaymentDone" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
